ORDINANCE XIV OF 2021
PUNJAB TRAVEL AGENCIES (AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2021
An Ordinance to amend the Travel Agencies Act, 1976
[Gazette of Punjab Extraordinary,
25th March, 2021]
No.
Legis:13-49/2019, dated 25.3.2021.---The
following Ordinance promulgated by Governor of the Punjab is hereby published
for general information:
It
is necessary to amend the Travel Agencies Act, 1976 (XXX of 1976) for
adaptation of the Act of 1976 in terms of the Constitution (Eighteenth
Amendment) Act, 2010 (X of 2010), and for the ancillary matters.
Provincial
Assembly of the Punjab is not in session and Governor of the Punjab is
satisfied that circumstances exist which render it necessary to take immediate
action.
In
exercise of the powers conferred under clause (1) of Article 128 of
Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan, Governor of the Punjab is
pleased to make and promulgate the following Ordinance:
1. Short
title and commencement.---(1) This
Ordinance may be cited as the Punjab Travel Agencies (Amendment) Ordinance,
2021.
(2) It
shall come into force at once.

Amendment of Act XXX of 1976

4. Amendment
of section 2 of Act XXX of 1976.---In
the Act, in section 2:
(a) after
dause (a), the following clauses (aa) and (aaa) shall be inserted:
"(aa)
"Controller" means the Controller as appointed under the Punjab
Hotels and Restaurants Act, 1976 (LXXXI of 1976), and includes a Deputy
Controller, an Assistant Controller and an Inspector, and such other persons as
may be authorized by the Government by notification in the official Gazette to
perform all or any of the functions of the Controller under this Act;
(aaa)
"Government" means Government of the Punjab;"; and
(b) for
clause (g), the following shall be substituted:
"(g)
"tourist" means a person who travels within the Punjab for, touring,
recreation, sports, study or religious pilgrimages or for any other purpose as
the Government may, by notification, specify.".

8. Insertion
of section 6-A in Act XXX of 1976.---In
the Act, after section 6, the following section 6-A shall be inserted:
"6-A.
Powers of Controller.---Without
prejudice to any other powers of the Controller under this Act, the Controller
may:
(a) seal
a travel agency if it is not licensed under this Act;
(b) seal
a licensed travel agency if it fails to deposit the annual fee or it does not
comply with the directions of the Government issued from time to time;
(c) inspect,
during working hours, the office or premises of a travel agency or of a guide
to ensure that the office or the premises is maintained in accordance with the
rules and terms and conditions of the licence;
(d) require
assistance from the district police for implementation of this Act; and
(e) impose
administrative penalty provided under section 14 of the Act.".

Amendment of section 7 of Act XXX of 1976

10. Amendment
of section 13 of Act XXX of 1976.---In
the Act, for section 13, the following shall be substituted:
"13.
Appeal.---(1) Any person aggrieved by an order under this Act may, within
thirty days of the date of such order, prefer an appeal to-
(a) the
Deputy Controller, where such order has been passed by an Assistant Controller
or an Inspector;
(b) the
Controller, Where such order, not being an order passed in appeal under clause
(a), has been passed by a Deputy Controller; and
(c) Secretary
to the Government, Tourism Department, where such order, not being an order
passed in appeal under clause (b), has been passed by the Controller.
(2) Secretary
to the Government, Tourism Department may of its own motion, or on the
application of any owner or manager of a travel agency aggrieved by an order
passed under subsection (1), except an order under clause (c) of subsection
(1), within the prescribed time and in the prescribed manner, pass such order
in relation thereto as it thinks fit.
(3) No
order against the owner, manager, partner or director of a travel agency shall
be passed under this section unless he has been given an opportunity of showing
cause against it and of being heard.".

the Act, for section 14, the following shall be substituted:
"14.
Penalty.---Any travel agency which contravenes or fails to comply with the
provisions of this Act or the rules or violates, the prescribed code of conduct
shall, without prejudice to any other action that may be taken against it under
this Act, be punishable, for the first offence, with fine which may extend to
one hundred thousand rupees and for subsequent offence with a fine which may
extend to two hundred thousand rupees or with the sealing of the premises or
both.".

respect of anything which is done in good faith under this Act.".

13. Substitution
of section 15 of Act XXX of 1976.---In
the Act, for section 15, the following shall be substituted:
"15.
Delegation and supervision.---(1) The Government may, by notification in
the official Gazette, direct that any of its powers under this Act shall, subject
to such conditions as may be specified in the notification, be exercised by the
Controller or any other officer of authority of the Government, in such manner
as may be prescribed.
(2) The
Controller may, by notification in the official Gazette, delegate any of its
powers under this Act to the Deputy Controller, Assistant Controller and
Inspector.
(3) Subject
to the provisions of this Act, the Controller shall perform functions and
discharge duties under the general supervision and control of the Government.
(4) Subject
to the provisions of this Act and of such orders as may from time to time be
made by the Government, Deputy Controllers, Assistant Controllers and
Inspectors shall exercise their powers and perform functions under the general
supervision and control of the Controller.".
